text:
Just having a Pokémon with you doesn’t make
you a real Trainer, you know.\c
Proper Trainers raise their Pokémon up to be
first-rate in battle, too![VAR 0114(0005)]

Oh, and you think you’re worthy of calling
yourself such a proper Trainer already, Hop?\c
Guess I’ll be the judge of that!\c
Let’s see how you handle yourself in a battle
against your friend, if [VAR 1100(00FF,0100)]she’s up for it.[VAR 0114(0004)]
What do you say? Willing and ready to take Hop\non in the first-ever Pokémon battle of your life?[VAR 0114(0004)]

Then how about I give you a spot of advice.\c
You don’t want to go getting so caught up in
things that you forget everything you’ve
accomplished till now.\c
Take a moment to jot down what you’ve done,
in order to save a record of your progress![VAR 0114(0004)]

Believe in your partner Pokémon!
And care for them, too, with all your heart.\c
Do those two things, and I’m certain you’ll learn
to choose the moves that suit your Pokémon.\c
And more importantly...to have a champion time
battling with them![VAR 0114(0004)]
Looks like everyone’s on board, Pokémon and\nTrainers alike? Then let’s do this![VAR 0114(0004)]

I’ve watched every match that Lee’s ever had!\c
I’ve read every book and magazine he left
behind at home, too!\c
I know exactly what to do in order to win![VAR 0114(0005)]
Well, that was a shock! Guess I know now why\nLee thought he should give you a Pokémon, too...[VAR 0114(0005)]
Sorry, mate.\c\nEven if you did get your Pokémon direct from\na champ like Lee, looks like I’m still the greatest![VAR 0114(0005)]

You and your Pokémon all fought hard.\c
Made me almost want to let out Charizard and
join in on all the fun!\c
Good effort out there, [VAR 0101(0001)]!
Why don’t I get you all sorted?[VAR 0114(0004)]

And, [VAR 0100(0000)], you’ve got real promise!
In fact, I’ve got a favor to ask you...\c
Be a real rival to Hop, would you?
Push him, and make the both of you stronger![VAR 0114(0004)]
Me and [VAR 0101(0002)] are ready to have a\ngo at you anytime![VAR 0114(0005)]
